suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-13 adds this draft-primary relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. The evidence synthesis addresses urinary incontinence after radical cystectomy with orthotopic neobladder reconstruction for bladder cancer; the approved mapping is restricted to that postoperative treatment pathway. Require documented bladder cancer, radical cystectomy with orthotopic neobladder reconstruction, and persistent separately established postoperative urinary incontinence. Do not infer urinary incontinence from bladder cancer alone, from an ileal conduit without the phenotype, or from transient early postoperative leakage. Preserve urinary tract infection, retention or overflow, neurologic or pelvic-floor disease, preexisting urinary incontinence, and other etiologies as competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
